title: Ultimate Horror Combo
description: Just some horror mods bunched into a modpack, took a good hour to find them (i had to download them all)
body:
Once, my friend asked. "Dude these modpacks are buns, we need an actual scary one." So i made this modpack to shut him up, let's go through of what it is.
This is Ultimate Horror Combo. [UHC], this uses old minecraft graphics so it can give you a scare and some Nostalgia, equipped with some of the scariest mods it IS supposed to scare you, if it doesn't you honestly might be brave lol, what are the best times to play this? probably around somewhere to 9pm-12am-5am, it's up to you! so i do hope you enjoy this modpack, and get a little spooked of course, i'll go into detail for you on what's in this mod.
Shaders - Pretty sure you can't equip them, but if you can they are there!
Horror Mods - Pretty explainable, but ill name the ones in here, The One Who Watches, The Boy From The Bath, Goatman, CANTBREATHE, Twixxel's Stalkers, wonderland.jar, the rest is for you to see.. *wink wink*
FPS mods - Just some FPS mods, just incase you are running this on a low end computer, mainly Sodium carries this mod on its back though.
Hope you'll enjoy this terror of a modpack i made, see you here! and remember to stay safe, love you!
